title: Liquidity, Business Cycle, and Shale Updates

assessment: The update properly recognizes the RRP escape route and retains uncertainty around markets. The clear misses are the upcoming stagflationary recession, next-year oil stagnation despite falling rigs, and overstated EPD distribution growth. Spot ETF access and uranium direction receive credit with explicit causality and return limits.
